title: CHROME COLOGNE
sourceDescription:
Let's get dirty again. 😈

Chrome Cologne is a place for music, creativity, and freedom. At its core is an immersive hard techno experience where people come together to dance, express themselves, and enjoy the moment.

As a sex-positive event, Chrome Cologne also offers an optional playroom. Participation is entirely voluntary. No one is expected or pressured to take part. The dancefloor remains the heart of the event.

Awareness Comes First

Creating a respectful and as safe as possible environment for all guests is our highest priority.

Our Awareness Team is present throughout the entire event and can be easily identified by their printed Awareness shirts and blue LED lights. In addition, there is an Awareness Point located at the entrance of the playroom, where a team member will always be available to assist you.

If you feel uncomfortable, experience harassment, or need help for any reason, please speak to us at any time. If you notice someone who may need support, we appreciate you informing our team as well.

In addition to the Awareness Team, you can also approach the bar staff, cloakroom staff, or security personnel.

dbDescription: Welcome to Chrome Cologne Chrome Cologne is a place for music, creativity, and freedom. At its core is an immersive hard techno experience where people come together to dance, express themselves, and enjoy the moment. As a sex-positive event, Chrome Cologne also offers an optional playroom. Participation is entirely voluntary. No one is expected or pressured to take part. The dancefloor remains the heart of the event. Awareness Comes First Creating a respectful and as safe as possible environment for all guests is our highest priority. Our Awareness Team is present throughout the entire event and can be easily identified by their printed Awareness shirts and blue LED lights. In addition, there is an Awareness Point located at the entrance of the playroom, where a team member will always be available to assist you. If you feel uncomfortable, experience harassment, or need help for any reason, please speak to us at any time. If you notice someone who may need support, we appreciate you informing our team as well. In addition to the Awareness Team, you can also approach the bar staff, cloakroom staff, or security personnel. Playroom Rules The playroom is a protected space for consensual encounters. The following rules apply without exception: Consent is key. Only a clear "yes" means yes. Always ask before observing, touching, or joining others. Respect personal boundaries without discussion. Treat all guests with respect and discretion. No drinks are allowed inside the playroom. Violations of these rules will be addressed consistently by our team. Dress Code Chrome Cologne is built on individuality and artistic expression. The dress code is an integral part of the concept and will be checked at the entrance. Examples of welcome attire include: Fetish wear Latex Leather Rubber Metal elements Masks Kinky fashion Creative and unconventional looks Bold and stylish outfits This list serves as guidance and is not exhaustive. What matters is not a single item of clothing, but the overall impression of your outfit and a visible engagement with the event's concept. The following are not permitted: Everyday clothing Regular jeans Cargo pants Tank tops Tracksuits Basic rave outfits without creative expression Cotton underwear Simple skirts or basic fashion made from everyday standard materials without a creative connection to the concept The dress code does not mean that you must show skin or dress revealingly. Creativity, personality, and a willingness to be part of the overall concept are what matter most. Our experienced entrance and sorting team will evaluate each outfit individually within the overall context of the event. The decision of the staff is final and binding. Guests who do not meet the dress code requirements will not be admitted to the event. Changing facilities and a cloakroom are available on site. If you are unsure about your outfit, feel free to bring an alternative. You may also contact us up to 24 hours before the event at outfit@chromecologne.com. Phone-Free Event A strict no-phone policy applies throughout the entire event. Smartphones must be checked in at the cloakroom unless there is a medical necessity requiring access to the device. In such cases, stickers will be provided to cover the phone's cameras. Guests who violate the phone policy will be required to leave the event. Together We Create the Space Chrome Cologne thrives on mutual respect, openness, and mindfulness. Look out for one another, support each other, and help create a space where everyone feels welcome, respected, and comfortable. Age for Admission 18 years / Einlass ab 18 Jahren! All sales are final / Jeder Kauf ist endg&uuml;ltig No refund by artist cancellation / Kein Umtausch bei Artist Absage For identification and as proof of age we only accept an official ID: identity card, passport, driver's license. We cannot accept these documents as proof: Student ID, health insurance card, bank card/credit card, photos or scans of any identification documents. Ticket-Weiterverkaufsinformation Der Ticketk&auml;ufer darf keinen h&ouml;heren Preis als den auf der Karte angegebenen Preis verlangen, wenn das Ticket an dritte weiterverkauft wird. Der Besitz der Tickets verbrieft KEIN Zutrittsrecht zur Veranstaltung. Zutrittsberechtigt ist, wer das Besuchsrecht selbst aus offizieller Quelle erworben hat und f&auml;hig ist diese Veranstaltung zu besuchen. Tickets, die als verloren oder gestohlen gemeldet werden, oder mit einem Preisaufschlag weiterverkauft werden, werden gesperrt!
